text:
Selena: Heads-up: final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + launch posts. Need: hero versions, quick benchmark blurb, webinar hook, and form routing. Short replies pls.

Omar: Hero candidates (very short): Hosted: 'Launch inference in minutes' Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity, predictable latency' Private: 'Inference inside your network' Keeping parallel phrasing.

Tariq: Benchmark angle for social: focus on two metrics: cost/token and P95 latency. Draft social line: 'Benchmark: 45% lower cost/token with Redwood Optimize + consistent P95 latency' Use a small bar chart and one-sentence caption.

Jo: Webinar hook: 'Operational inference: deploy, measure, reduce cost' 30-minute slot: 12m demo (hosted), 10m ops (dedicated), 8m security (private). Registration form should ask deployment interest so we can route.

Selena: Routing plan proposal: separate hidden tag from utm_content mapping to tags: hosted_interest, dedicated_interest, private_interest. Hosted -> SDR nurture, Dedicated -> AE queue, Private -> Solutions Eng. Also capture variant_id for A/B.

Omar: Landing CTAs: Primary 'Register', Secondary 'Compare modes', Tertiary 'Contact sales'. Compare page public; compliance checklist for Private gated.

Tariq: For forms, minimal fields: name, email, company, role, use-case (checkbox), deployment interest (radio). Private selection shows privacy blurb: 'We only use your info to arrange enterprise follow-up.' Jo will confirm legal.

ops-bot: Reminder: assets due in 48h. Please upload hero images + benchmark chart to /launch/assets (placeholder).

Selena: Social copy A/B headlines: A) 'Ship reliable LLM features faster' B) 'Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency' Which one for main post?

Jo: Pick B for launch post. Higher signal for enterprise. A for quick funnels.

Omar: I'll draft final hero copy and two alt headlines by EOD. Tariq will attach chart CSV. Selena will update the routing sheet.

Selena: Owners: Omar (web copy), Jo (webinar & legal), Tariq (benchmarks). Closing once PR merges. :rocket:

(End of thread)
